data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Elevation Level 1
levels.description: Subtle elevation shadow with 10% black opacity and 2rem blur. Used for cards and floating elements.

levels.name: Elevation Level 2
levels.description: More pronounced elevation shadow with 10% black opacity and 4.375rem blur. Used for modals and prominent floating elements.

levels.name: Header Border Shadow
levels.description: 1px bottom border shadow using theme border color for header separation.

levels.name: Secondary Button Border
levels.description: Inset 1px border shadow for secondary buttons using theme border color.

levels.name: Secondary Button Border Hover
levels.description: Inset 1px border shadow for secondary buttons on hover with darker border color.
